crossRefs.note: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who…

translations.web: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.
translations.bsb: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
translations.kjv: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
translations.asv: And the beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goeth into perdition.
